title: High Regards
content:
How much more prolific,
 of a writer,
 I could become?

If only advanced by age?

I searched longingly
 for some poetry to indulge in,
and what I found
 wasn't satisfactory.

These poets,
 albeit literate and eloquent,

 lacked abstraction.

Lacking the romance that writing brings.
Rooted solely in events,
 poetry inspired by experience,

rather than for expression of misunderstanding.

And I found this to be disappointing.
Such writers are heralded as great,
 who acclaimed?
Perhaps I am lacking in the richness of my perception,
but these writers of acclaim fall short;

Of my artistic glory.

title: Ebb Tide
content:
In my youth,
 I thought it wise to mark my name
 on the face of the Earth;

 In my adolescence
 I thought it better to mark my name
 in the stars;

 In my present
 I find it best to mark my name
 in those hearts.

 The Earth will be consumed,
 the stars will become dim.
 The hearts of those will not let go,

 until the brink sets in.

 Perhaps it is narcissistic
 to wish for such grandiose of a legacy…
 But man inherently strives for such.
 I am no exception.

 I have stared longingly into space,
 just as I have my lover’s;
 Longing all the same…

 to be remembered.

 For who am I without my memories?
 My trials and struggles;
 who am I without a thought to my being?
 Though I recognize I am more than that;

 my soul seeks something more than that.

 “Like a tide at its ebb,
 I’m at peace in the web of your arms.”
 But I never am,

 and I never will be.

title: Dear John Merrick
note: After watching The Elephant Man in my interpersonal communications class, I felt compelled by the story of John Merrick and wrote a poem about the discrepancy between him and the world
content:
I see those luxurious amenities;
 And architecture so grand;
 understanding it is not meant for me.

 And my words be set in stone;
 ever so in my poetry.

 So how then can I condemn myself?

 For it I know all too well in my ego now,
 that my vanity is certain.

 I have seen your loving heart.
 I have observed your gentle soul.
 How can man possibly be so abhorred?

 To wish so sorrowfully for such things,
 is to neglect that which I have;
 and that which you,
 were ultimately thankful for.

 You are no monster.
 But I?

 I am a disgusting excuse for a man.

title: Disgust
content:
Your temptation is disgusting;
 and it disgusts me.

 I am a modern day philosopher
 through and through.
 And I find my stance on this societal norm
 to be quite reminiscent
 of those who held it previously.

 I find my values to be quite synonymous
 with those ancient founders of present thought.
 Those men were praised in their time,
 and even acclaimed today.

 But for I to conclude the same as them;

 scorn.

 To be labeled a labeler;
 oh the hypocrisy…

 Men of acclaim today;
 sit on their mighty throne.
 Enshrined by politicians,
 enamored by the masses,
 lifted high in praise
 due to their success
 in having such a remarkable mind.

 Though I suppose it is just as evil to envy,
 than it is to gloat
 in such a position.

 A truly wise man concerns himself not.

 However;
 I stare in discontentment
 as I contemplate my life.

 Ninety nine times ninety men
 doing quite the opposite.
 I am a genius with respect to the masses.
 I am an idiot with respect to logic.
 For in my mind
 this mentality is not useful.
 To them who deem themselves wise,
 it is the only thing
 that holds but any value.

 Because they lack true abstraction.

title: Escape
content:
Everything feels useless.
 I feel empty.
 And hot-headed.
 And directionless.
 And I am scared.
 I feel purposeless.

 In this music,
 in this life.
 It’s all too complex.

 And my mind is filled with patterns.
 And my soul is filled with sounds.
 And spring is beautiful.
 But I want more than here.
 I want a fantastical world to escape to.
 But I suppose
 I can’t avoid this place forever;
 this beautiful sun.
 These familiar smells.

 Am I doomed?
 Does this graphite make it so?
 Do these songs fill me with hope?
 Or are they another escape?

 Will anyone ever read my writing?

 I am certain they will.

title: Romanticism
content:
I am a man
 with dreams too big
 for his own heart.

 I am a god
 who cannot even control himself.

 I hate it all;
 yet I can hold a conversation.

 I am bound and amazed
 by my own mind.
 I chew and bite my way
 out of this body.

title: Cruelty Dissonance
content:
We rode out onto the water,
 and I took in the breeze;
 these March days;
 coming April showers
 remind me of not so long ago
 when I rose up on that hill

 and saw her.

 And my heart was set ablaze,
 and the music filled my ears…
 For in that moment
 I saw true beauty
 undisputed;
 unrequited.

 She was so pure;
 and so precious;
 uncorrupted by sin.

 The pain was never intentional.

 How is it
 that I can write so lovingly
 about someone who hurt me?
 Surely this must mean that love;
 is more powerful
 than pain.

 Truly I tell you,
 living has been a joy.
 Through every tide;
 through every calm.

title: Shoulder
Hesitancy
content:
I feel as if my very existence
 has lost its meaning.
 And my timely soul
 is out of its home.

 So many books left behind.
 Just like centuries old.

 My heart torn in three,
 my love lost its life.

 Wherefore I go?

 I know the truth makes me ugly.
 and destitute.
 And it scares me
 when it all feels too real;
 it all feels too fake.

 God I asked for signs
 and they leave me the very next day.

 I feel the tears well up
 and I get I cannot cry.

 Words words words.

title: Suspense
content:
I am a bit fearful.
 At the prospects of life…
 All this talk of success,
 how am I to succeed?
 With what attributes,
 do I determine the future
 I have been set with?

 I am a flightless bird,
 at the entrance of heaven.

 I am a powerless ram,
 at the stairway to hell.

 Imagine sitting on the rings of Saturn…

title: Contrary
content:
As I return to the valley
 of the shadow of death,
 I longingly wish for simpler days.

 My curls hang low
 on my shoulders.
 Wishing,
 waiting for a miracle.

 As the whispers hit my ears;
 memories collide in a simple,
 unyielding way.

 Abstraction ruling over everything.

 I am inevitably
 a vagabond;
 corpsed to a life of romance;
 yielding love.
 And poems yielding faith.

 I turned to look beside me;
 and I see them in the distance,
 like pillars of my past.
 Cracking in the face of my present.
 Collapsing in the advent
 of my future.

title: Veiled
content:
I will let the ravens
 pick apart my throne;
 the tree-tops
 are threatening me from a distance.

 My poems are still riddled
 with discrepancy.
 But there is a face in my dreams,
 they yell;
 they scream.
 But I don’t hear a thing.

 The skies fill with artificial smoke,
 as they block the sun.
 A poison in the air.
 Collapsing my lungs.

 The face gets closer to me.
 The look of myself.

 The unwavering sun.
 An evil reminds me in the day.
 Cast aside your disbelief.
 Look up unto the stars.
 And become helpless.
 And the monster
 whispers to me a sentence.

 Which I cannot refuse to acknowledge.

 They are right.
 It existed;
 despite its disappearance.
 I will let the ravens
 peck every bone.
 If it means the annihilation
 of my retrospection.

 The wind is my enemy;

 only when I write.

title: Paranoid
content:
I am hurt.
 Torn by the past
 of what was;
 irreversible to a less hopeful picture in front of me.

 Though my love may adapt;
 that beauty
 will never return to me.

 I am scared;
 tortured by the thoughts
 that plague my existing life.
 Never a corner that turns
 which I am not paranoid…

 I am lost.
 For my love,
 for my peace,
 had since left me.
 And left me
 with no choice but nihilism.

 The world is dark;
 my letters so far as to repetition.

title: Hurt
content:
I stare into the eyes
 of the one who resents me,
 and I do not look away.

 Pain has filled the beating heart
 of those I have dismayed.

 Blinded by a madness
 that bled into my water;

 I break apart the only people
 who I called the others.

 Tune in hard,
 I play a song.
 A melody complete.
 Forevermore;
 I tip over
 and let the blood cover my feet.

 Listen close
 to him who hears;
 and has the eyes to see:

 A spinal column decompressed
 by his society
 mix and matched
 I told a tale as bright and tall
 as a star.

 Never once;
 did I ever think
 I’d be the epitome.
 I cannot remove you
 from my screen,
 your eyes
 they bleed right through.

 At last I take my final breath.
 Looking at
 your darkened hue.

title: Vanity
content:
Never to be found
 is how I intend to live;
 but fame in any respect
 sounds amazing.

 Critical of every flaw;
 and imperfection.
 Up until this day,
 not for them,

 still not for me.

 And it remains the only success.
 Behind these almond eyes

 is something far more profound.

title: Jagged Crooked
content:
Every waking moment;
 I labored towards destruction.
 I close my eyes
 and revel in the disastrousness of reality.

 Shield my eyes from this pain;
 from this carnival.

 The piano ringing;
 the light of my life beginning.

 Dine in my fantasy.
 Feast upon every aspect of me.
 Feast,
 feast;
 devour.
 Until I am no more.

 Kill me;
 so slowly;
 that I fall in love
 with the idea of death.

 Play for yourself a song;
 composed by yours truly;
 and watch my anger quell.
 Watch the raw emotion boil.

 And I’ll write
 and write
 and write
 and rip apart every aspect
 of myself.
 My anger giving me insight
 into who I am;

 because they were.

 I am that canvas.
 Reflective of every embodiment.
 And I find that it is sharp,
 and blocky
 and crooked like my soul.

 Blaming those that control me
 for all my insecurities.
 Finding that I am too guilty
 for all my crooked ways.

 All my complaints
 contributing to nothing;
 and crescendoing when I create.

 I pick apart everything;
 in a vulnerable display of love for myself.
 Only to die to these words tomorrow.

 How beautiful could I be,
 if only I were special?

title: Condemnation
content:
In the desperation towards greatness;
 I have fallen to envy.
 This envy
 has led me down a path of sin.

 In my attempts for discipline,
 I am reminded of this evil.
 Hoping not only that
 I can be redeemed
 for my lack of control,
 but that in my strive for more;

 my lack can catch up.

 In my pursuit of discipline,
 I have encountered many devils,
 much like myself.
 These devils
 plague my mind with lethargy.
 For the greatest damnation to an artist;

 is to riddle them with sloth.

 The greatest weakness to a creative;
 is to take away his mind.
 I am an artist without a single medium.
 And I somehow make time to write.

 Read these words carefully;
 my writing is inspired by song.
 Thus once I find the perfect song;

 I can write something to end it all.

title: Dimentia
content:
My mind is beginning to decay.
 With every mention of my memories
 I lack it more and more.

 Who will take my journals;
 is there a man that is worthy?
 Who will carry on,
 that I can remember?

title: Existentialism Short
content:
To me,
 there is no comfort in the infinite.
 Only an end to fear.
 Perhaps this is what they fear…
 Those who seek to dim our illuminance.

 I suppose that after eons;
 I’ll be ready to ascend.
 But for now;
 in my finite mind,
 no philosophy can suffice;

 no excuse can soothe me.

title: Face on my journal
content:
Lay down for the 6,150th time.
 Dream just the same,
 let all your earthly worries
 carry you away.
 Into a world
 of your own design…

 Do you miss the skies?
 I grieve that I cannot grieve.
 I laugh at the pain
 that ails me.
 And when silence whispers;
 I hear not its wisdom;

 for my ears are not open,
 and my eyes cannot see.

 I blame no one but myself.
 My sight was once open;
 my ears once heard.

 Laboring over disastrous,
 instead of a salvation
 once redeemed.

 Why do I toil to perfect
 something that is beautiful,
 imperfect?

 I spent every second of my past
 envisioning my future.

title: Mindfulness
content:
One day our reservoir will dry up,
 and theirs will overflow.
 One day the light we hold so dear,
 will no longer illuminate the darkness.

 Ash will weigh heavier
 than the fires that created it.

 This is the future of our world.

title: Envy
content:
“Oh my heart aches so frivolously.”

 I cannot bear the pain in my lungs.
 From head to toe,
 my body cries,
 but I cannot mend it.
 I cannot heal it.
 For this insatiable taste
 can only be satisfied by one;
 by another.

 I just want to recall
 a recollection of times,
 living life so blissfully,
 not a single care in mind.

 But now the troubles of the age
 have caught up to me.
 So cold and bittersweet.

 I envy all the other boys.
 For them,
 I cannot compete.
 The sadness of the century
 leaves me looking quite the fool,
 when compared to all the problems
 the army faces on their own.

 I just want someone to hold me.
 So maybe I can hold them back.
 The jealousy fights heavily
 in this poor old soul.
 I'm blessed from inside out,
 but with no one to share my world.

 God, I really hate this feeling,
 and I don't use that word a lot.
 But seeing them so happy
 scares me until I'm not.

 There's a million cataclysmic things
 that could end the world tonight,
 so I'd rather spend my evenings

 with someone by my side.

title: Grandmas Sky
content:
A siren sounds,
 a window blows,
 the final minutes,
 despots fall.
 Everyone stands,
 awaiting all beyond what seems so far.
 What felt so long…
 Destined were you?
 Doomed are you?
 Can it fit?
 The words?
 Can you describe the scene?
 Is it difficult?
 In my mind,
 I see it clearly.

 I see it beautifully,

 the past and present
 all at once,
 all together.

 Keep on bawling.
 It will solve nothing.
 The galaxies are meant for exploring.

 A crimson chromosome,
 throughout your body.
 Memories lost forever?
 Could any single man
 create something so vast?
 So clever?

 Lavish and loving,
 disruptive corrupting.
 I'll wait forever;
 tied together.
 Let us dance.
 Cosmic tremors;
 crafted carefully,
 woven pieces,
 sewn like feathers,
 among the void;

 It is now or never.

 He made a promise.
 He'd watch them all.
 But soon they'd fade like everything else.

 Obelisks watch from the shoreline.
 They're scattered all over the earth.
 The architects saw
 that they were pleasing,
 as they had spent a millennium
 in an attempt to perfect.
 And the edifices still remain a mystery.
 Without a single moment to spare,
 men set out on a journey,

 a voyage.

 (This poem had no date)

title: Apologies, Helios
content:
The sun beats down on me harshly;
 as my body rejects its rays.
 In an almost unfamiliar sense,
 as if I haven't dedicated
 odes to his name.

 Helios,
 you are my lover;
 and I harm myself
 through you.

 Your rays become incessant,
 as your light
 hits the fog of my mind.

 I use you as a photo prop
 and disrespect your nature.
 And yet,
 your glow never diminishes.
 How do you remain so radiant?
 How do you maintain your soul?
 Like clockwork,
 you oscillate.

 To be more like the sun
 is all I wish.
 In correspondence with the laws,
 complacent in my space;
 and everlasting.

 I stare into your majesty,
 and as warm as it may be;
 I am rendered blind.

title: Apologies, Luna
content:
My lover once gave her name;
 one I have since forgotten.
 She claimed to tell her stories,
 ones I have since forgotten.

 I was unfamiliar;
 as I conversed with the trees.
 However,
 Luna stands as a silent aspect
 in the nights I have come to dread.
 And a somber reminder
 in my times of retrospection.

 For a feeling from her
 I have yet to feel,
 no warmth,
 no love,
 no grief.
 And like an unknown soldier,
 I have long since ignored.

 You peek through my shattered shutters
 with a gentle light
 unto my face,
 longing all to be heard.

 I am aware
 you carry a message;
 one I do not wish to hear.

 She still sings her sorry
 sonnets to you;
 whereas my messages
 are on the wind.

title: Dear Mother
content:
Time is passing unremorsefully,
 not waiting a second
 for us to catch up.

 And once again we find ourselves
 in the midst of a letter;
 this time,
 digitalized,
 though the sentiment remains the same,
 a cloud cannot fade
 as a paper can.
 For as long as there is a web,
 this poem will live on.
 Symbolizing the everlasting,
 unending romance,
 of these humble words.

 Every may or so,
 I write again to you
 who has read
 and understood.
 And so I will continue to do,
 until separation.

 I must admit,
 I am scared of the future,
 more often than I accept it.
 And I can become so enraptured
 in the dramatics;
 that I can forget
 the truly important relationships.
 This isn't to say
 I don't notice them...

 I know things are complicated,
 and life feels not unlike
 Ouroboros devouring himself continuously;
 however,
 even if you cannot always see it,
 life is so much simpler
 than anything we can conceive.

 When we make it to heaven,
 if we ever do,
 we always say we'll be at peace...
 But to balance the peace,
 and live in accordance
 with the laws;
 Suffering is inherent.
 And there is a certain beauty
 in it all.
 Life from pain,
 death from life,
 a smile after the tears.
 And I am well aware of the confliction.

 'To live with pain is painful,
 a pain I do not wish to feel.'
 The very reason we write
 and sing
 and dance
 and live,
 is all an attempt to ease the pain.

 Though I have no material possessions,
 that can soothe a tired soul;
 surely solace can be found
 in my words now:

 I know that inside you,
 there is someone
 comparable to myself,
 scared,
 confused,
 and anxious,
 with every step that proceeds.
 Despite that,
 you carry the burden
 that those before you could not.

 No one asked you to become who you are;
 you found it within yourself
 to grow
 and learn
 and create.
 And now a life surrounds you
 that wasn't determined by fate.

 So screw the complications,
 and throw away the sense.
 For in my eyes reflected,
 is a woman
 who put her life on the sidelines

 at my expense.

 So even if you never ever hear it
 from anybody new,
 you can live and die
 a humble life,

 knowing that I had always
 Loved You.

title: WANNABE
content:
Society frowns on those
 with alternative ideals;
 often sentencing them to silence
 or ridicule.

 "But who decided this?"
 a 'crazy' man will ask;
 "Our founding fathers
 were surely not brazen,
 and yet they rebelled against a system?"
 Why all the praise,
 to a man whom I emulate?

 "Hypocrites,"
 he cries.
 "Hypocrites."

 And still his passion burns
 like a child who never worked,
 and the passerby
 will walk right by; saying:

 "I wish that I could be;
 like him."

title: WANNABE Pt. II
content:
Death is such a fragile concept;
 and life is not kind
 to those who question its authority.

 It seems not unlike an unfair obligation,
 the unknowingness,
 the unwillingness.
 To be created;
 to die.

 "Suffer it not" to give birth,
 the antinatalist cries;
 and life continues despite him.
 The wishes,
 and realizations,
 fall flat
 at the orders of God;
 and still he defied death.

 When my body decomposes,
 my soul will surely have been separated,
 my ego searching for a way
 back to my mind.
 "Is this the price I pay?"
 I ask myself.
 "Shall I raise a life like this?"

 Yes.
 Because birth is a curse;
 but death is a solution to
 our sin.

title: WANNABE Pt. III
content:
Humanity has conquered itself.
 The lust of its nations so great,
 the fall of its people will be satisfying;
 as I fall with them.

 Endless centuries ago,
 a system was created for survival;
 but also power.
 Millennia ago,
 sin was born into this world,
 and out from it,
 a colossal threat so great;
 it plagues mankind even today.

 No human act has been justified
 in true selflessness,
 and still;
 the most closely justified act,
 is to take another life.
 Conviction drives ideals,
 ideals into morality,
 morality;
 into the justification for murder.

 And the eradication of all morality is close.
 We are reaching the limits of our grace.
 Shall we continue in sin?
 No.
 We will extinguish all remembrance of our history.

 In the end,
 the air pipes of the living will cease to inhale new life.
 A stain will be made to signify our existence.
 A cross will be hung to signal our return
 to the unwavering darkness.

 Let every soul disappear.
 In the deserving hellfire,
 for good.

title: WANNABE Pt. IV
content:
Finally.
 A worthy soul.
 And damned is he,
 and to the world disgraced.
 By both heaven and by earth;
 his freedom has been lost.
 A divine entrapment,
 of endless torture.

 Perhaps,
 just maybe,
 another soul exists.
 Perhaps the bond is real,
 and the time spent in agony
 may be lessened.
 And the abhorrence of humanity
 may lift ever so slightly.

 The piano man has sold his soul,
 and I envy him.
 While even though his lights extinguish;
 they rise;
 they fall;
 they exist.
 They play.
 They suffer not.

title: WANNABE Pt. V
content:
Turn your back to the world
 and let your tears hit a silent tune.
 A single stain is worth much more,
 than the devastation of your view.
 You realize you're in your world,
 and this life is just a play;
 but to be a part of it-
 would be to admit that in it you had no say.

 The peace of stillness
 comes at the cost of everything you 'love',
 and chasing ideals,
 good or bad,
 if the binary even exists;
 will only lead you into confusion.

 One who plays the system
 is not him who escapes it.
 So you turn away and realize,

 you are nothing
 like him.

title: A Penman's Anguish
note: I wrote this in a sketchbook early in the morning as I lamented on my inability to express and articulate as well as other poets
content:
I have called myself a poet,
 and to this day,
 I dedicate my time to destruction,
 becoming all that I hate.

 My journal has not seen an entry,
 and in it,
 I am afraid to write;
 as it displays the passage of time.

 How loathsome I am portrayed,
 and even to myself, dismayed.
 All chances at poetry,
 fall flat at the feet of my fear.

 My inspiration is my experience,
 though I advocate for abstraction.
 As soon as my muses had left me,
 my poetry became dull
 and quiet.
 My literature,
 my pen,
 my art,
 all torn,
 and torn just like my heart.

 I call myself a poet
 without a sense of self.
 I call myself a monster
 as my fangs deteriorate.
 I hate your soul;
 penman,
 for your words have become weak,
 and I envy the other artists because of you.
 Your lexicon is tiny.
 You can never craft a rhyme.
 A dead poet,
 and you know it,
 and you're almost out of time.

 This life on Earth,
 the life beyond,
 and all of it combined.
 You fill yourself with content about the topic
 to plague your mind,
 in hopes that by a miracle,
 you can somehow be easier to find.

 And through it all,
 your poetry is a tired dead embodiment,
 of those you left behind.

title: An Eligiacal Reflection
content:
My hands can craft an archive,
 as they have done before.
 And I used to mention violins,
 the ones I tried to play;
 and now abhor.

 Your touch on me is ever present,
 as I'm sure they have assured.
 But seeing you with a smile,
 after all,
 has me longing for another.

 In my heart,
 I have established that love
 is a frivolous pursuit.
 However,
 ever since that night,
 I have never been the same.
 And as the eclipsed moon hung over us,
 my soul was set on fire.
 My mind,
 like tangled wires in the night.
 Footsteps tapping,
 people laughing,
 and a song played just for you and me.

 For a moment,
 I didn't correct myself,
 and I let the entropy of all that is
 and will be,
 slip away.
 Reminiscing on the pictures I still carry.

 Be it God that changed my fate,
 or the demons who intervened,
 my loss is only temporary;
 for you taught me that love was not
 what I was seeking.
 But rather,
 understanding.

title: Heaven's Hypocrite
content:
One look at my surroundings,
 and abhorrence
 cannot define my emotion.

 Guilt for the guiltless;
 how pathetic...
 Envious of the guilty;
 how poetic...

 A pedestal is established
 to separate myself from the evil.
 And I climb it up and down
 in search of some painless truth.
 Judgment only suiting;
 only belonging,
 to me.

 Though it should be applying,
 to the devil who is crying,
 "Sinner! sinner!"

title: Deprivation
content:
Touch me.
 Make me feel loved.
 Obsess my mind,
 fill every page with your presence.
 Linger on my body;
 a remnant of affection.
 Flourish in my love for thee,
 without a moment of retrospection.

 Heal me,
 hold me.
 Become all that I fear.
 Terrified to love that which provides me.

 My raw,
 unwavering chamber
 of inhibitory lust.

title: Sacrifice
note: Though I wish and pray for marriage, I can't help but acknowlegde that some of the greatest works in history were done in heartbreak and pain. This poem is about that feeling. During my life I've had many (Personally) devastating events, that have all yeilded incredible works of art, specifically poetry. Whenever I reach a point of complacency in my day to day, I feel my works lack the richness they once had; and so the struggle between great art or comfort ensues. Do I risk the holy matrimony for 'Words and Sounds and Hues'?
content:
And to a man is promised;
 a bride unto his feet.
 And thus this man acknowledged,
 continued on in sin despite the price.
 "Save yourself for brighter days,
 if vows are what you seek."
 Knowing that patience yields unfathomable rewards,
 such art cannot be created otherwise.
 And heartbreak is a wonderful muse.

 And so he traded eternity;
 for words
 and sounds
 and hues.

title: From My Dreams
content:
From where I stand
 I see you.

 Leave me here,
 in pursuit of those
 pretty dreams.

title: Struggle
content:
My ear hurts from all the music.
 My eyes are sore
 from the restless nights.

 I awake from a sleep
 that felt so shallow
 to a world that felt so small.
 And in my youth,
 I would be at peace in my ignorance.
 I trusted blindly,
 and now my sight is unveiled
 to a less optimistic outcome.

 In this reality,
 I understood that there was no Father.
 I accepted that there was no God.
 And my current self couldn't help
 but agree.

 I am angry with you God.
 I have so many queries.
 I have so many thoughts.
 I have dedicated my life to a man who doesn't speak,
 because he died for me.

 You came and lived my life
 to serve as an example of perfection,
 and sacrificed yourself to yourself
 to quell an anger I didn't cause.

 Still,
 among all speculation,
 who establishes virtue?

title: Sound Out There
content:
I look at my face in the mirror.
 And it seems unfamiliar;
 Dark and gruesome.

 After 48 hours awake;
 My reflection became paranormally hostile.
 Outside is a floating island.
 An atomic bomb has hit the earth.
 And I am flung into my bookshelf.

 My hair is in my face.
 And it curls into my eyes.

 Close to my face,
 the ink seeps in through my nose,
 my fingers,
 and my skin.

title: Drive By
note: Every time I observe my good fortune, I greive those less fortunate, as I recognize what I often take for granted. During the writing of this poem I was communicating that being homeless would be a more just outcome for my circumstances, seeing as I've done little to earn what I have been blessed with. With everything and more one man is unsatisfied; and with nothing to his name, another is complete.
content:
I am not deserving
 of what I have been blessed with.
 I am not earning
 the life that I have been a guest in.

 If I could be a homeless man,
 my life would be at peace.
 Because I simply cannot comprehend
 why I am worthy of these amenities.

 I am half a man with all my worries,
 that come solely from inside.
 And still my eyes reflect an empty hall
 when faced with all my lies.

 I look for all the missing pieces;
 as I peer through the lack.
 Yet your puzzle is completed
 by the robes upon your back.

title: A Disgusting Self-Sabotage
note: I feel I often work against myself in the pursuit of peace/health. And the detremental habits I have lead me to view innocence as something that I negatively affect. And though this is not neccissarily true, this poem is about that feeling of disgust for the self.
content:
Tonight I laid my hand atop your head.
 The one defiled by sin.
 I use these hands to destroy,
 create,
 and relish in the pleasures of reality.

 And still in love.

 How can I look at you in innocence,
 Knowing who I am?
 Knowing what I've done?
 My mental projections,
 A wicked obsession in my sleep;
 my dreams are plagued by succubi,
 my days are left feeling weak.

 My hands are used against me;
 as I chase my heart's desire,
 and like a single puff of air;
 I extinguish my own soul's fire.

title: Dunce
content:
Will i toil to perfection?
 The canines; they cannot...
 The artists hunger,
 the painters vision,
 my words like thunder
 yet to ring throughout the earth.

 I am silent,
 and so were they.
 But now the papers are piling up,
 and only to my dismay.

 Van Gogh sat an empty cell,
 a view to replicate;
 my lovely words they linger only to decay.
 No christened box to hold a single sonnet that I've made.
 And still my pencils break faster
 than my tears could hit my face.

 The mutts they run through forests;
 point their noses to the divine;
 a natural beauty that pushes past a paint brush
 while they're alive.
 Give them a pen.
 See what they do;
 and yet I'm accounted for?
 Does this mean that my life
 is that much more valuable than yours?

 Oh how I labor towards a fate that never moves...
 They tell me I will never be remembered
 unless I take my hammer to the stone.

title: Closet
content:
I smelled your pillow case today,
 the one that I once held.
 My tears welled up,
 the scent it faded;
 as from my nose the cushion moved.

 I wonder how it moved so fast?
 How the love it turned to hate...
 How different life
 it could have been;
 If I hadn't realized too late.

 I used to take these pictures of you;
 you'd always cover your face;
 and now I know the reason why.

 You were disgusted and ashamed.

title: Bully
content:
"When I open my mouth, all I see is imperfection."
 Like a rotting gateway;
 the entrance to hell.

 I fear an approach.
 I fear my internal self has corroded
 and now leaks through my teeth.
 My smile never widens;
 my eyes they never lift.
 My hands carry cuts and bruises;
 but for them I have pockets.

 I am comparable to Narcicuss;
 yet what is reflective is a facade.
 A face that is so beautiful,
 with a mind that is so wrong.
